$comment: Machine-readable companion to docs/PRODUCTION_CUTOVER_RUNBOOK.md. Tracks the phased rollout from foundation-only to a durable production deployment. No secrets here: env vars are listed by NAME only, classified secret vs non-secret. Update `status` as phases complete. This file is descriptive — nothing reads it at runtime.
guardrails: Read-only by default: GTM_MCP_ENABLE_WRITES/PUBLISH/DELETES stay false.
No token bytes in Postgres or repo; bytes only in the vault via token_ref.
api/** import-safe: node:* + import type only at module load; clients lazy-load after auth.
Consent Mode v2 suite stays 170/170 (npm run test:consent).

phases.name: Postgres / Supabase schema deploy + read-only probe
phases.goal: Provision DB, apply schema, flip persistence readiness to ready. No app reads/writes yet.
successCriteria: all tables present, RLS enabled (not forced) on tenant-scoped tables
phases.rollback: Unset DATABASE_URL/PORTAL_DATABASE_URL and redeploy; stateless path resumes.
security: connection string is a platform secret

phases.name: Token vault integration + dual-read/dual-write
phases.goal: Move OAuth token bytes out of the cookie into a secret manager; v2 session-id cookie with v1 fallback.
validate: psql "$DATABASE_URL" -c "SELECT token_ref, scopes, has_refresh FROM oauth_connections LIMIT 5;"
successCriteria: fresh login mints v2 cookie with no token bytes
existing v1 sessions keep working (no forced re-consent)
refresh writes bytes to vault, never to Postgres/cookie
phases.rollback: Stop minting v2, keep v1 acceptance; unset vault vars.

phases.name: Redis / Upstash cache (read-through + SWR)
phases.goal: Hot cache for discovery lists (SWR) + short-TTL status lookups.
successCriteria: repeated discovery call shows a cache hit
status endpoints never served stale; reflect terminal state within one TTL
phases.rollback: Unset cache vars or set GTM_PORTAL_CACHE off a live backend; CacheStore no-ops.

phases.name: Async job queue (shadow mode)
phases.goal: Enqueue + process audits/captures in shadow; client response unchanged until 202-poll variant is opted in.
validate: psql "$DATABASE_URL" -c "SELECT status, count(*) FROM worker_jobs GROUP BY status;"
successCriteria: every audit/capture enqueues a worker_jobs row reaching a terminal state
client response byte-identical to pre-shadow synchronous response
phases.rollback: No-op the JobQueue / unset JOB_QUEUE_PROVIDER; synchronous path is the only path.
security: worker upload uses bearer token not session

phases.name: Runtime worker deployment (behind the queue)
phases.goal: Deploy headless-Chromium worker on a real browser host; switch to queue mode.
successCriteria: HTTP mode returns a redacted artifact within timeout
queue mode leases + processes a seeded job to succeeded; artifact has expires_at
phases.rollback: Scale worker to 0; unset PORTAL_RUNTIME_WORKER_URL. Config-only audits unaffected.

phases.name: Observability exporter + alert activation
phases.goal: Wire metrics exporter to the sa_* contract; activate alert thresholds. Logs already emit.
validate: force a synthetic 5xx and confirm the alert fires + resolves
successCriteria: structured logs in sink carry traceId/orgId but no token bytes/emails/raw captures
sa_* metrics + derived rates render in the backend
high-severity alerts fire on synthetic trigger
phases.rollback: METRICS_ENABLED=false / unset OBSERVABILITY_PROVIDER; structured logs keep flowing.
security: redact() on every field; low-cardinality labels only

crossPhaseSecurityChecklist: No token bytes in Postgres (only token_ref + metadata).
Vault-only byte resolution via backend service identity; TOKEN_VAULT_ALLOW_MEMORY unset in prod.
No secrets in repo or shared cache; NEVER_CACHE holds.
Runtime captures redacted/encrypted, expires_at (30d), never logged raw or served unredacted.
RBAC: viewer read-only; no portal-grantable *:publish; cross-tenant denied before role (-> 404).
Read-only defaults intact; publish stays MCP-guardrailed even after approval:decide.
